title: volunteer manifest: status field for pause/resume
description:
Add a `status` field to the volunteer manifest to support pause/resume.

The manifest currently has fields: version, license, gates, allowed_paths, egress_allowlist, sandbox, max_wall_clock_minutes, task_label, local_ok.

Add a new `status` field with values "active" (default) and "paused". When status is "paused", the manifest still loads/validates/digests normally but the index (browse) should skip it, and the publish wizard should be able to set it.

Changes needed in `src/bernstein/core/volunteer/manifest.py`:
- Add `status: str` to the `VolunteerManifest` dataclass (default "active")
- Add `status` to `_KNOWN_FIELDS`
- Add `_load_status()` validator: must be "active" or "paused"; defaults to "active" if absent
- Add `status` to `to_canonical_dict()`
- Add a `MAX_STATUS_LENGTH` or just validate the two values

Also add a `is_active` property or update `browse_indexes` in `registry.py` to skip manifests where `status == "paused"`.

Update docs: `docs/reference/volunteer-manifest.md` to document the new `status` field.

Acceptance:
- Manifest with `status: "paused"` loads and validates
- Manifest with `status: "active"` loads and validates
- Manifest with `status: "vibes"` raises VolunteerManifestError
- Manifest without `status` defaults to "active"
- A paused manifest digests differently from an active one (so policy can't change under the same digest)
- The loader warns about known-but-unrecognized status values appropriately

Tests: add to `tests/unit/volunteer/test_volunteer_manifest.py`
